key_relationships.theme_a: Critical Thinking and Cognitive Skill Development
key_relationships.description: Pedagogical Applications explicitly enable Critical Thinking development through strategies like GenAI pedagogy, evidenced by the subtheme 'Critical Thinking through GenAI Pedagogy' within the Critical Thinking theme.
Integration of GenAI tools into teaching methods associates with measurable improvements in learning outcomes, as implied by pedagogical impact descriptions and outcome-focused research.
Challenges in implementation (e.g., technical barriers, ethical concerns) directly influence how pedagogical applications are integrated, forming a recurring barrier-to-application dynamic.
